cards.h: SpaceXSI credits Grok Voice with 5 million patient calls at Innovaccer. Innovaccer's own release says those came first
cards.p: Healthcare software company Innovaccer is adding Grok Voice to its patient-calling AI agents. SpaceXSI's post pairs the deal with "over 5M patient interactions," but Innovaccer's release describes that figure as its own voice AI's growth before Grok. What the deal covers and what's only a roadmap.

cards.h: "52% dilution" in a SpaceX-Tesla deal doesn't mean 52% more shares. I ran the math from both companies' filings
cards.p: Tesla and SpaceX shares fell again on Wednesday as investors weighed a possible all-stock merger. Gary Black's widely quoted "52% dilution" figure checks out, but several outlets described it as SpaceX issuing 52% more shares. Using the share counts in both 10-Qs, the issuance would be more than double that.

cards.h: SpaceX turns down its BEAD money and offers to serve those homes for $0. What the government's new contract actually requires
cards.p: NTIA published a model "zero outlay" agreement on 23 Nov for a low-orbit provider that serves its BEAD locations without taking the subsidy, and NTIA's head says SpaceX has agreed to it. I read the 15-page contract: free equipment, 100/20 Mbps, ten years, and a lot less paperwork.

cards.h: The FCC has authorized SpaceX to deploy up to 1 million Starmind satellites as orbital data centers, the first such authorization in U.S. history
cards.p: The FCC on 25 Nov 2026 granted SpaceX authorization to deploy up to 1 million Starmind orbital compute modules, the first U.S. authorization for a constellation of data centers in space, according to an official Commission release posted by Chairman Brendan Carr. The grant authorizes deployment. It does not set a launch timetable.

cards.h: A space jellyfish is a rocket plume lit by sunlight while the ground is still dark. The best window is 30 to 60 minutes before sunrise or after sunset
cards.p: A space jellyfish forms when a rocket's high-altitude exhaust is still in sunlight and the observer is already in darkness. Vandenberg officials, who also call it twilight phenomenon, say it usually appears two to three minutes after a launch 30 to 60 minutes before sunrise or after sunset. USSF-380 this Saturday is a night launch, not a twilight one.

cards.h: The EU has postponed its Tesla Assisted Driving meeting to December 15. A rejection would invalidate national approvals already granted
cards.p: A European Commission spokesperson told Reuters on 25 Nov 2026 that the EU meeting expected to consider bloc-wide approval of Tesla Assisted Driving has been postponed until December 15. A rejection at EU level would invalidate the national approvals already granted. No reason was given.

cards.h: Virginia and Oregon sue SpaceX over Grok's sexualized images. Here's what the two complaints actually claim
cards.p: Two state attorneys general filed consumer-protection suits against SpaceX, SpaceXSI and X over Grok-generated sexual images, including of children. I read both complaints: the claims, the penalties allowed, and what X says in response.

cards.h: Tesla's official Robotaxi page now shows more than 6 million autonomous miles. The last dated safety results still stop at 3.1 million on 18 Oct
cards.p: On 24 Nov, Tesla's live Robotaxi counter stood at more than 6.01 million autonomous miles. The official safety results still cover 22 Jan to 18 Oct, when the fleet had driven 3.1 million miles.

pins.p: Upside down on a ramp, over five Teslas, 0–60 under 0.59s. $50,000 to reserve, production 2028.
